name: MUTEX
description: Head-to-head trading tables for a USDC pot, plus perps, options, AI agents, a bot-friendly prop trading desk & more.
longDescription:
For serious traders: 
A trading terminal on Lighter, built around the Arena: traders compete head to head on a clock, for a USDC pot, on real orders.

Around it sit perps and spot, options, a prop desk, AI agents, strategy bots, vaults, index funds and a funding-rate farm. One account, one balance, one interface.
